description: Request and response limits enforced by both the backend (contract.py, config.py, chunking.py, chunked.py) and the frontend (src/lib/contract.ts). Tests on both sides assert they match this file. maxTotalChars is the request text envelope (fully processed in AI_MODE=chunked); the default single-call mode rejects text above singleCallMaxChars with an explicit error. Timeouts are failure ceilings, not a latency target.
